sections.note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Appenzell; other communes in Appenzell Innerrhoden set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).
